Together they cover the same specific subject matter of rate definitions and fair value status for these subsets.

comparisons.peer_topic: Fair value option election for asset-backed secured financings to reduce volatility
comparisons.peer_summary: The Corporation elects to account for certain asset-backed secured financings under the fair value option to reduce accounting volatility caused by the asymmetry between historical cost accounting for the financings and fair value accounting for the securing mortgage LHFS.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs and Bank of America elect to account for specific categories of secured financings under the fair value option to mitigate accounting mismatches or volatility. GS applies this to '$27.99 billion' of other secured financings as of Dec 2024, while BAC applies it to certain asset-backed secured financings to reduce volatility from asymmetry between historical cost accounting for financings and fair value accounting for securing assets.

sentences.text: • Other secured financings included $27.99 billion as of December 2024 and $12.55 billion as of December 2023 of financings accounted for at fair value under the fair value option.
The Corporation also elects to account for certain asset-backed secured financings, which are also classified in short-term borrowings, under the fair value option.

Election of the fair value option allows the Corporation to reduce the accounting volatility that would otherwise result from the asymmetry created by accounting for the asset-backed secured financings at historical cost and the corresponding mortgage LHFS securing these financings at fair value.
